name: ViewSpatial-Bench-vlmeval
description: ViewSpatial-Bench-vlmeval evaluates a model's ability to reason about spatial relationships and viewpoints in visual-linguistic scenarios. It measures understanding of object locations, relative positions, and viewpoint-dependent queries across images and paired text prompts. The benchmark is intended to stress spatial reasoning capacities of VLMs rather than general visual recognition.
reputation: A targeted, research-oriented benchmark for spatial/view reasoning in VLMs with limited but growing use among researchers focused on compositional visual reasoning.
